metadata.description: Official Mentionlytics skills for Claude: work with the Mentionlytics API for social listening, brand monitoring and AI visibility, and manage trackers.

plugins.name: mentionlytics-api
plugins.description: Query and manage a Mentionlytics account through the Mentionlytics API (v2): mentions, sentiment, top mentioners and keywords, geo/language breakdowns, AI daily summaries, analytics (EMV, MQI), audience demographics, AI Visibility answers and citations, account usage, and creating, updating, pausing and deleting trackers and tracker groups — with token refresh and rate-limit handling built in.
